Usage: memoriahub backup run [options]

Run an incremental backup sync into the configured backup root

Options:
  --concurrency <n>  Concurrent download workers (default: backup.concurrency
                     setting, 2)
  --max-mbps <x>     Aggregate bandwidth cap in Mbps; 0 = unlimited (default:
                     backup.maxMbps setting, 0)
  --page-size <n>    Change-feed page size (default: backup.pageSize setting,
                     100)
  --json             Emit NDJSON events instead of human output
  --strict           Exit non-zero when any item failed
  --reconcile        Force a full reconcile pass (manifest diff + quarantine)
  --embedded         Force the in-process engine even when a daemon is running
  -h, --help         display help for command
